description: Abstract class for a Vert.x-based Hono protocol adapter using CoAP, providing resource management, server setup, security configuration, message forwarding, and lifecycle handling.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedCoapAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for a Vert.x-based CoAP protocol adapter in the Hono framework, managing server lifecycle, resources, security, and message forwarding.

methods.name: setHonoDeviceResolver
methods.description: Sets the service for resolving an authenticated CoAP client to a Hono device.

methods.name: setPskStore
methods.description: Sets the service for looking up pre-shared keys for DTLS handshake authentication.

methods.name: setMetrics
methods.description: Sets the metrics reporting object for this adapter.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns the metrics reporting object.

methods.name: setResources
methods.description: Adds CoAP resources to be managed by this adapter.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default secure CoAP port.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default insecure CoAP port.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Retrieves the actual port of the secure endpoint.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Retrieves the actual port of the insecure endpoint.

methods.name: setCoapServer
methods.description: Sets the CoAP server instance to be used.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Starts the CoAP server, configures endpoints, and resources.

methods.name: addResources
methods.description: Adds configured resources to the CoAP server.

methods.name: bindSecureEndpoint
methods.description: Configures and binds the secure DTLS endpoint.

methods.name: bindInsecureEndpoint
methods.description: Configures and binds the insecure endpoint if enabled.

methods.name: preStartup
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform actions before startup.

methods.name: onStartupSuccess
methods.description: Hook for subclasses after successful startup.

methods.name: getSecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Creates and loads network configuration for secure endpoint.

methods.name: getInsecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Creates and loads network configuration for insecure endpoint.

methods.name: loadNetworkConfig
methods.description: Loads network configuration properties from a file.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Allows subclasses to customize messages before sending downstream.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Stops the server and performs cleanup.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses before shutdown.

methods.name: postShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses after shutdown.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedExtendedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the authenticated device identity from a CoAP exchange.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Forwards telemetry data to the southbound API.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage
methods.description: Forwards event data to the southbound API.

methods.name: doUploadMessage
methods.description: Handles forwarding of messages to downstream APIs with error handling and metrics.

methods.name: isGatewayMappingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if gateway mapping is enabled; always returns true.
